slides: It's you waiting for the time to be perfect
Edison didn't wait for everything to line up He started with what he had
If you're smart enough to try
If you have something worth making
BUT YOU WAIT FOR THE CONDITIONS TO BE PERFECT
Then you never start at all
Waiting is just fear with a better name
Start today Follow for the backbone nobody gave you
caption:
You have conditions right now. Men who build never wait for perfect. This is the discipline separating successful creators from dreamers who never start anything.

Start your first attempt today. Edison tried 10,000. You need to try one.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
